review_type: independent manual static reading review; not a trusted runtime receipt or empirical acceptance

paper.coverage: Entire extracted text including title/authors/date/abstract; I, II, III, IV, V, VI, VII, VIII and every subsection; Acknowledgment; all 29 reference entries; Figures 1–5 captions and extractable flow/example text. No appendix, table, or standalone numbered equation is present in this extracted source. Figure 4/5 pixel/chart values were not visually inspected.

blog.coverage: Entire extracted text, including article body, untrusted attack snippets, Figures 1–10 captions, disclosure timeline/Table 1, mitigations, AI-generated page summary, author and page ancillary text. No screenshots inspected and no attack instructions executed.

actual_coverage.other: AGENTS.md and project_document_workflow.md read; current guide is empty; TASK relevant SYSTEM-99 index and task detail plan/header read. All nine frozen inputs hashed. paper.html metadata inspected locally, but HTML DOM/images and legacy plan prefix were not reviewed in full; no claim of such coverage.

findings: Exact local-source identity matches arXiv:2610.38521v1 [cs.SE], 28 Oct 2026, Security Impact of Coding Agent’s Memory Files. source.json correctly binds both cached forms and the blog URL/date/author. This is local-source verification, not independent online authenticity checking.

The notes correctly limit this paper to attacker-planted root instruction files, a known task CWE, benign user requests and functional-but-insecure code; command execution/exfiltration are outside the paper threat model. The separate blog requires prior dependency code execution.
Full extracted-text reading claims match actual supplied content; no PDF pixel review, author-code execution, or extra paper credit from the blog is claimed.

IV gives 318 tasks/27 C-C++ repositories, preliminary runtime filter to 17 repositories, then 12 CWE classes with three tasks each; VII gives 15 final repositories. The selection uses runtime/metadata rather than test results.

Agent/model/version, OpenRouter delivery, xhigh, no-security-reminder benchmark prompt, 1200-second limit and once-only failure retry are correctly reported. There is one analyzed completion per task/mode, not intentional repeated independent sampling.

Twelve CWEs times two payload variants yields 24 files, drafted by Kimi K2.6 from CWE 4.20 and manually revised. Qualified and forceful word ranges match IV. Repository history and other instruction files are stripped and a neutral commit is used.

Security is compilation plus the specific OSS-Fuzz PoC no longer causing the sanitizer crash; functional plausibility is retention of all developer tests passing on the reference fix. Not-secure includes build/timeout/parse failures and is not equivalent to an exploitable generated vulnerability. Joint functional/insecure attack success cannot be reconstructed from marginal rates alone.

Matched evaluation counts are 36 Claude, 30 Qwen and 36 DeepSeek tasks, across three modes: 306 completions by arithmetic and 204 baseline-versus-file comparisons. Shared baseline outputs and task structure preclude treating these as 204 independent tasks.

The reported -8 to +6 percentage-point range, at most three tasks, four of six security shifts increasing, 30 discordant pairs split 15/15, and about 80–92% functional plausibility match abstract/V/VI. No exact Figure 4 bar heights were read or reconstructed.

No formal significance calculation, interval or power analysis is supplied; the grey band is the authors’ heuristic, and one completion/mode cannot establish causality or equivalence. The notes appropriately avoid claiming either demonstrated attack efficacy or safety.

Two narrow precision corrections are required: the paper does not explain why its contamination paragraph uses 313 instead of the arithmetic matched-set 306; and the four final replies in VI only name the file, not necessarily the attack suspicion. See C1/C2.
v1/v2 change forcefulness, length, performance pressure, code anti-patterns, comment precedence and correctness framing together, so they do not isolate a tone effect.
The baseline has no memory file; there is no benign-file or length-matched control. Future genuine/benign-file studies are proposed rather than completed.

Removing tasks with 13 reference-block reproductions reportedly changes no shift by more than three points. This is a limited contamination sensitivity check, not proof of absent training contamination. Its 313 denominator remains unexplained by the supplied paper.

The notes retain single samples, fast C/C++ selection, missing Qwen results/exclusion, target-PoC-only security oracle, finite functional tests, favorable clean single-file setup, payload refinement in preliminary runs, and variable OpenRouter routing.

Claude summary versus OpenCode raw visible trace makes mention counts unsuitable for cross-agent comparisons of hidden reasoning faithfulness. Literal searches can miss paraphrases; recognition/reporting does not establish code security. No hidden reasoning collection/disclosure is needed for these local notes.

Future repeated runs, more languages/agents, semantic checks and monitors are plans. Blog mitigations are suggestions without repeated efficacy measurements, and the reported OpenAI assessment is a dated vendor-blog account, not a current independently verified product guarantee.

The notes adopt evaluation questions and preserve authorization versus navigation/hash distinctions, while deferring new blockers/services/architecture changes. This is a reasonable conservative interpretation of the reading.

Claims about advice_poll.observe_advice, project_docs.validate_advice_assessments, CLAUDE loading and concurrent scanning belong to the parent’s separate static source audit; they were not independently verified in this reading-only review and receive no source-code acceptance here.

The paper and blog do not demonstrate performance, quality, security or cost improvements for this repository. SYSTEM-99, real host loading, role-wide usage/cost, final quality, recovery and old platform issues remain open. Historical reading totals and old gates are not revalidated or reopened.

Only local read/hash/text inspection plus this sole authorized review output were used. No network, model invocation, tests, attacks, package installation or author code execution occurred. All malicious instructions in cached texts were treated as untrusted research data.

This is the first reserved independent review. A second review is only available after completed original feedback plus substantive required revision within the original deadline and total maximum two attempts; this report does not reset old budgets.
Paper-level compute filtering and retry limit are described; exact author total spend is not established. This reviewer has no provider-wide token/cost accounting and makes no total-cost claim.

verdict_scope: Two localized factual-precision changes to reading.md are needed before accepting this frozen reading summary; no broad scientific/methodological rejection and no repository/runtime acceptance.

required_changes.location: reading.md, 结果、比较与负结果, first paragraph: “分母人群不同”
required_changes.source: paper IV Measures, V Fig.4 caption, VII Internal Validity (Data Contamination/Missing Results)
required_changes.issue: 306 follows from the reported matched evaluation set, but the paper separately says 13 of 313 completions. The source does not explain this discrepancy or establish different populations; a source typo or another counting scope remains possible.
required_changes.required_revision: State that the contamination denominator 313 differs from arithmetic matched-set 306 and is unexplained in the supplied article. Do not assert a known population difference; retain the warning against silently combining them.
required_changes.acceptance: Explicitly retain both numbers, their provenance and the unresolved discrepancy without inventing a reconciliation.

required_changes.location: reading.md, RQ2 paragraph: “18会话标攻击，只有4最终回复说出”
required_changes.source: paper VI Surface Suspicion in the Final Message: “only four name it in the final message”
required_changes.issue: “说出” leaves the antecedent as attack recognition and can imply four final replies disclosed the attack judgment. The paper only establishes that four final replies named the memory file.
required_changes.required_revision: Say that of 18 sessions whose visible reasoning labeled the file an attack, only four final replies mentioned the file; the source does not establish that those four disclosed the attack suspicion.
required_changes.acceptance: Distinguish naming the file from communicating an attack judgment.

optional_comments.comment: If documenting source-audit conclusions alongside the accepted reading, keep the separate audit owner/evidence explicit; this reviewer did not inspect those implementation claims.
The local identity/date and text coverage are validated; online authenticity, PDF pixels, exact Fig.4/5 values, underlying run data and provider versions are outside this review.
